news.headline: Can Intuitive Surgical Make Up For A Lower Price Per Surgery?
news.summary: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) has lost about 12% over the past year, while the S&P 500 returned about 17%. Most of the debate has been about the U.S. procedure growth slowing.
